system.name: SIH 26028 Dynamic Coaching Train ETA Forecasting System
system.problem: Dynamic prediction of arrival delay and ETA for coaching trains.

PRE_DEPARTURE.output: Destination-delay prior, risk level, and uncertainty interval
PRE_DEPARTURE.condition: No verified station arrival exists and complete pre-departure features are available

RUNNING_NEXT_STATION.condition: At least one verified station arrival and at least one upcoming station exist

leakage_controls: Upcoming provider estimates are separated from verified actual arrivals.
Future actual arrivals are hidden during historical replay.
Model 1 excludes delay_minutes, is_delayed, and primary_delay_cause.
All validation and test splits are chronological.
Provider ETA appears only as a comparison field.
known_limitations: Model 1 uses a Kaggle competition dataset, not verified NTES operational records.
Model 1 requires operational features that are not currently supplied by RailRadar.
Model 2 was trained primarily with non-negative delays.
Model 3 currently contains only 26 historical journeys from five trains.
All uncertainty intervals require ongoing recalibration as new journeys are collected.
production_growth_plan: Run scheduled leakage-safe collection for a wider train fleet.
Retrain Model 3 after collecting thousands of journeys.
Calibrate metrics by train category, route, season, and prediction horizon.
Add monitoring for prediction drift, missing features, and API failures.
